name: llama: add Maple 20B-A1B ternary MoE architecture (CPU) (#27000)
summary: Merged llama.cpp pull request adding DeepGrove's Maple 20B-A1B ternary MoE architecture, CPU-only through TQ1_0/TQ2_0 kernels.
description: Pull request #27000 in ggml-org/llama.cpp adding the Maple 20B-A1B architecture: 24 layers, 256 experts (8 active), SWA-512 interleaved with global attention at 3:1, ternary weights packed as TQ1_0/TQ2_0. Ported from deepgrove-ai/llama.cpp with their permission and split into four commits: gguf-py constants, converter, architecture, test entry. CPU-only for now; test-llama-archs -a maple passes (NMSE 8.75e-08). Merged 14 Sep 2026 after a long review thread on perplexity numbers.
contains: 24 layers, 256 experts (8 active), SWA-512 with global attention at 3:1
ternary weights via TQ1_0/TQ2_0, CPU-only for now
ported from deepgrove-ai/llama.cpp; test-llama-archs -a maple passes (NMSE 8.75e-08)
smoke test on M4 CPU: ~216 t/s prefill, ~88 t/s generation (TQ2_0)
review thread compares perplexity for TQ1_0/TQ2_0, TQ2_0 vs q2_0 and CUDA vs CPU
